content:
tanya: Quick Q: for docs PRs that only update SDK snippets, should we require CODEOWNERS review? Lots of churn.
kevin: We currently route /docs/** to @docs-team. It's noisy.
maya: My preference: keep CODEOWNERS for guide-level edits but allow snippet churn via a `snippets/*` exception or a labeled auto-approve workflow.
devx-bot: Note: previous incident #231 showed accidental bypass when auto-approve action had write token. Ops required service account instead.
kevin: Ops ok with a `docs-ci-bot` account that is a CODEOWNER for `docs/snippets/**` only. That solves the noise.
tanya: Sounds good. What's the rollout plan?
maya: I'll draft the CODEOWNERS split and a short GH Action to auto-approve when `docs-ci` label is set and preview passes. Will route through ops for the bot account creation.
anya: thanks!
